calibration.reference_state:
截至2026-11-10，Rocket Lab 已发布FY2026 Q3结果与Q4指引（E188、E189）：收入2.67834亿美元、同比增长73%，超过公司此前2.50亿–2.65亿美元指引；季度末backlog约35.7亿美元、环比增长52%，新增近10亿美元发射合同，Neutron签约任务达到16项、多个Q3任务按7000万美元新基础价售出，下一可订窗口在2030年代。另一方面，Q3 GAAP净亏损约7968万美元、摊薄每股亏损0.12美元，调整后EBITDA亏损约1805万美元、自由现金流为负2392万美元；Q4收入指引为2.70亿–2.90亿美元、调整后EBITDA仍指引亏损1400万–2000万美元。单季经营现金流转正主要来自可变的卫星项目里程碑回款，不代表持续现金转正。Neutron首飞现为2027年（首飞所需步骤的2027Q1目标来自E114，E188未将其改写）；公司仍承受研发、资格与商业化时点风险。E190的1.5亿美元OSC贷款是首飞后制造升级/回收周转的附条件偿还型承诺，尚未财务交割，不应计作已到账补助或当前资格资金。
既有具名卖方基线仍包括Raymond James于2026-09-11首次覆盖并给出Outperform/80美元目标价，摘要将其理由联系到Neutron、Iridium/Mynaric机会及执行/整合/利润率风险，并称其预测2027/28年正EBITDA/FCF；原研报和完整模型未取得。Stifel文章正文标注2026-08-17，显示其维持Buy并估计Rocket Lab可能获得Viasat Swarm-1 award的可观份额（潜在高八位数美元机会）；这不是获奖份额、公司指引或新于该正文日期的11月观点。KeyBanc于2026-06-15升级至Overweight/135美元；E116记录其后因Neutron延期下修FY2027收入估计和目标价至100美元、仍维持Overweight。E116还记录Clear Street、Citizens和Goldman Sachs因Neutron延期调整目标/模型但维持各自评级，Cantor与Roth维持积极立场。
2026-11-10的Q3后分析师响应已纳入当前基线（E193）：Cantor将目标价122→111美元但维持Overweight，并以紧张的运力供给、Rocket Lab竞争位置/积压订单/发射记录为正面理由，称当前价位是Neutron商业化与Iridium交易前的有利买入机会；这项明确正面观点不因目标价下调而消失。Clear Street将105→110美元、维持Buy，并以记录backlog带来的多年业务可见度为由。KeyBanc重申Overweight/100美元并称已在业绩后修订估计（数值/期间未披露），同时提到运力紧张、定价与backlog。Barclays维持Overweight、目标价降至82美元并指出订单和提价；BTIG维持Neutral并以约24倍2027共识销售额对约10.5倍同业估值及待Neutron进展说明审慎立场。以上均为个别卖方判断，不构成一致预期、公司预测或已实现经营结果。
calibration.trigger_boundary: 一次公开、可归属到具名分析师/机构、方向明确的新独立观点即可跨界：新覆盖不需要该机构不存在的旧模型作比较；首次明确的Buy/Outperform等积极推荐或既有明确升级本身足以记录一个新卖方意见，即使摘要没有可量化的年度现金模型。非评级式的概率/时点/风险判断，或只有目标价变化的报告，则须提供足够公开理由把新结论连到RKLB业务/风险，而非只随现价机械调整。无需完整盈利桥、第二家跟随或公司经营兑现。2026-08-17 Stifel维持Buy并估计Rocket Lab可能取得Viasat Swarm-1 award可观份额、对应高八位数美元机会，现为已知的单一分析师历史估计；仅重复或在11月7日等feed日期重新索引/转载该内容，不构成新的观点。相对RJ、Stifel及其他具体已知基线的新估计/风险更新仍需有明确业务理由。若同篇对经营路径与peer估值方法给出相反变化，只在其总体推荐/估值结论或明确主导的新判断仍偏正面时命中；净方向不清时不由下游拼模型，C1不成立。 2026-11-10 E193中的Cantor、Clear Street、KeyBanc等业绩后观点现已是当前基线；同一意见的再次转载、同日财报汇编或只重列已知评级/目标价，不构成新的观点。Cantor下调目标价但明示有利买入判断，Clear Street的上调亦有backlog依据，应以报告明确表达的整体新判断定向，不从目标价单项机械推断。后续若同一机构对经营概率、时点、风险或价值作出相对该基线的真实新判断，仍可满足C1，无需等待实际兑现。

activation_conditions.criterion: 具名卖方机构首次公开给出明确偏正面的Rocket Lab推荐/独立基准，或明确上调其自身既有推荐，或在研报/有出处摘要中提出一项新的有利公司特定概率、时点或价值判断；首次推荐或明确评级上调本身可承载新的独立观点，单纯目标价变化则须能识别新的业务/风险依据，而非只随现价机械调整。

calibration.reference_state:
截至2026-10-16，公司Neutron首飞基线已由E114更新为2027年，原2026年窗口撤销，替换件使用改良工艺，执行首飞所需步骤目标为2027Q1。E116记录KeyBanc因少一次可产生收入的2027年Neutron发射而下调FY2027收入估计及目标价135→100美元（维持Overweight）；Clear Street将129→105美元（维持Buy）；Citizens将130→90美元（维持Market Outperform），称影响FY2027–FY2028发射货币化；Goldman将75→67美元（维持Neutral），模型采用2027Q2首飞并预计近端费用/现金消耗增加；Cantor维持Overweight/122美元、Roth维持Buy/110美元。2026-10-29 Simply Wall St报告自身估值约105.05→102.15美元并小调营收增速/净利率，但期间不明、不是具名分析师共识，主要沿用已知延期与费用风险。
2026-11-09 Q3实际披露（E188、E189）现进入基线：收入和订单/backlog强劲，Neutron共16项已签任务，若干新任务按7000万美元基础价；但GAAP亏损/EPS弱于分析师估计，调整后EBITDA与自由现金流仍为负，Q4仍指引亏损，Neutron首飞仍不早于2027年。增长、定价及已签合同不等于利润/现金已兑现；Neutron时间风险仍与财报实际相邻但不可重复计为新信息。
2026-11-10 E193中的负向基线是Piper Sandler将目标价83→58美元、维持Neutral，称季度稳健但Neutron时点是近期关键指标，尽管发射需求仍强。BTIG维持Neutral，列出约24倍FY2027共识销售估值对比同业约10.5倍，并称待Neutron进一步进展；这不是新评级下调。Roth下调目标价30美元、Craig-Hallum下调20美元，但已提供报告未披露其目标价前后值/评级/理由，不能据此推定负向经营预测。Cantor下调目标价至111美元仍维持Overweight并给出有利买入判断；Barclays降至82美元仍维持Overweight且强调订单/价格，均不能只按目标价方向判为新的负向观点。上述是具名个别报告事实，不是共识。
calibration.trigger_boundary: 一次公开、可归属到具名分析师/机构、方向明确的新不利观点即可跨界：新覆盖首次给出明确偏负的建议，或既有机构明确降级，本身是新的卖方意见，不要求完整年度现金模型；也可由公开的新判断显示推迟重要现金/商业化时点或降低关键路径实现概率。E114已披露的2027年首飞预期及Q1步骤目标，E116已披露的KeyBanc收入/目标价下调、Clear Street目标价下调、Citizens关于FY2027–FY2028货币化的下调及Goldman对2027Q2首飞/更高费用和现金消耗的模型，以及Cantor/Roth的维持立场，均是当前已知基线；对这些内容的复述、旧稿再刊、评级保持或基于历史事实的机械估值重算不触发。2026-10-29 Simply Wall St的估值及增长/利润率模型值也进入基线，但预测期间不明，不能作为共识或公司经营事实；仅重复该更新不构成新的观点。相对这些具体基线的新估计/风险更新仍须有明确业务理由；单纯无新依据的目标价变化或仅因股价移动而改目标价不足。无需公司丢单、实际财务下修或其他分析师跟随。若报告中的一项假设变差但整体结论因其他变化转为更有利，不机械认定SHORT；如经营和peer估值子项方向冲突且报告未表达主导/净结论，则本Condition也不命中。 E193中的Piper Neutron时点论据及83→58美元目标价已是当前C2基线；其后同一切价行动的新闻重述（包括仅重列相同目标价和同一已知理由）不触发。单独的Roth/Craig-Hallum目标价降幅，以及Cantor/Barclays保持积极评级下的目标价下调，也不足以证明新负向总体判断。若日后出现相对此基线的明确新降级、首次负面覆盖，或有出处且连接公司特定经营/风险的实质新下修，仍可触发；不要求其他分析师跟随或等实际经营恶化。

policies.match_scope: 匹配有明确出处、机构与分析师身份的Rocket Lab卖方研究、首次覆盖/独立基准、评级或核心假设更新；例如对Neutron资格与商业化时点、卫星及发射业务的兑现概率、待交割Iridium服务现金/风险，或这些公司特定路径所支撑的投资意见作出新判断。报道摘要可帮助召回，无需取得付费原研报；公司分析师名单只说明谁在跟踪，不是公司预测。通常评级复述、旧报告再刊、只有目标价对现价作机械调整的标题、股价升跌、财报/合同本身，以及仅发生同业倍数换算而未形成新的公司经营观点，不单独命中。

policies.title: 卖方对Rocket Lab经营前景与风险的独立新判断
policies.transmission:
截至2026-11-09，Rocket Lab FY2026 Q3收入为2.67834亿美元、同比增长73%，超过公司此前Q3收入指引；季度末backlog约35.7亿美元、环比增长52%，新增近10亿美元发射合同。公司同时报告Q3 GAAP净亏损约7968万美元、摊薄每股亏损0.12美元、调整后EBITDA亏损约1805万美元、自由现金流为负2392万美元；季度经营现金流虽为正约720万美元，主要受可变的卫星项目里程碑收款推动，前九个月经营现金流仍为负。FY2026 Q4收入指引为2.70亿–2.90亿美元、调整后EBITDA仍预计亏损1400万–2000万美元。这些实际结果和管理层指引方向并不单一，不能相互抵销为单一的盈利结论。

E189披露Q3新增八项Neutron任务、金额超过5.15亿美元，签约backlog为16项，多个任务采用7000万美元基础价，下一可订窗口进入2030年代；Neutron仍预计不早于2027年首飞，资格/制造与现金兑现风险未消失。E190另载OSC对首飞后制造升级、回收运输和缩短周转提供1.5亿美元附条件贷款承诺，财务交割仍待尽调和其他条件，属偿还型贷款，非补助或已到账现金。Iridium交易已由完成的ATM发行提供资金且股东/贷款人已批准部分条件，但交割仍待监管批准。

卖方研究将这些已公开经营路径转成各自的概率、时点和价值判断，是独立于经营消息本身的观察入口。Raymond James 2026-09-11首次覆盖的Outperform观点、正文标注2026-08-17的Stifel维持Buy及Swarm-1高八位数美元潜在份额估计、E116的延期后估计/目标价调整，以及E193的Q3后分析师群组观点均是个别模型或建议，不是公司指引、一致预期或已实现损失/收入。当前卖方一致预期、完整预测模型及同日企业价值/净债务/摊薄分母仍未充分取得；不由下游拼凑价格影响或共识。只有可归属到具名卖方的新独立方向性判断，或与公司特定业务/风险相连的实质新概率、时点或价值更新，才进入相应Condition。

w1_events.canonical_summary: Rocket Lab announced eight Q3 Neutron missions worth more than $515 million, growing the signed backlog to 16 missions and raising the base price to $70 million for several missions. The release identified several constellation customers and said the next booking opportunities were in the 2030s.

facts.proposition: Rocket Lab said it signed eight Neutron launch missions across five constellation operators in FY2026 Q3, worth more than $515 million; the total included the previously announced Kepler and SB-AMTI missions.
ICEYE signed for three dedicated Neutron launches beginning in late 2028.
Muon Space signed for two dedicated Neutron launches, one planned for 2029 and one for 2030.
Starcloud booked one dedicated Neutron launch planned for 2029.
One of the eight Q3 Neutron missions was a U.S. Space Force SB-AMTI mission.
Rocket Lab’s Neutron signed-mission backlog reached 16; the next available launch opportunities for booking were in the 2030s.
Rocket Lab raised Neutron’s base launch price from $55 million to $70 million, and several Q3 missions were sold at the higher base price.
Rocket Lab attributed the Neutron price increase and backlog growth to strong demand and constrained launch capacity.
Management said Neutron backlog missions were firm customer commitments with real deposits and cancellation fees; it did not disclose the amounts or fee rates.

w1_events.known_event_summary: On 2026-11-09, Rocket Lab announced eight Neutron launch missions worth more than $515 million across five operators; the backlog reached 16, ICEYE booked three launches from late 2028, Muon two in 2029/2030, Starcloud one in 2029, and the next slots were in the 2030s at a $70 million base price.
w1_events.title: Rocket Lab lands more than $515 million in Q3 Neutron launch contracts

w1_events.canonical_summary: Rocket Lab reported record FY2026 Q3 revenue, a $3.57 billion backlog and positive GAAP operating cash flow, then issued Q4 guidance for revenue of $270–290 million. The release and results call also addressed Neutron timing and economics, production and contract metrics, and the still-pending Iridium acquisition.

facts.proposition: Rocket Lab reported record FY2026 Q3 revenue of $267.834 million, up 73% year over year and $34 million sequentially; this exceeded its prior $250–265 million Q3 revenue guidance.
Rocket Lab’s FY2026 Q3 revenue of $267.83 million exceeded the analyst revenue estimate cited in the report.
Rocket Lab reported a FY2026 Q3 net loss of $79.677 million and diluted loss per share of $0.12, versus $18.257 million and $0.03 per share in FY2025 Q3.
Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 GAAP gross profit of $90.071 million and GAAP gross margin of 33.6%.
Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 non-GAAP gross margin of 38.4%.
Rocket Lab reported a FY2026 Q3 GAAP operating loss of approximately $79.2 million.
Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 adjusted EBITDA loss of $18.047 million, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately negative 6.7%.
Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 research and development expense of $98.388 million.

Rocket Lab reported positive FY2026 Q3 GAAP operating cash flow of $7.2 million, versus $84.1 million of operating cash use in Q2; operating cash flow for the first nine months remained negative $127.3 million.
facts.subject_time: FY2026-Q3 and FY2026 first nine months

facts.proposition: Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 non-GAAP free cash flow of negative $23.92 million.
Management attributed the Q3 operating-cash-flow improvement mainly to satellite-program milestone receipts and noted that such receipts are variable.
At FY2026 Q3 end, Rocket Lab reported backlog of approximately $3.57 billion, up 52% from Q2 end and a record.
Rocket Lab reported nearly $1 billion of new Q3 launch contracts across Electron, HASTE, and Neutron and a total launch backlog of 117 missions.
Rocket Lab reported signing $470 million in Space Systems contracts during FY2026 Q3.
Rocket Lab guided FY2026 Q4 revenue to $270–290 million, with a midpoint of $280 million.
Rocket Lab guided FY2026 Q4 GAAP gross margin to 34%–36% and non-GAAP gross margin to 39%–41%.
Rocket Lab guided to a FY2026 Q4 adjusted EBITDA loss of $14–20 million.
Rocket Lab guided FY2026 Q4 GAAP operating expenses to $162–168 million.
At September 30, 2026, Rocket Lab reported approximately $4.45 billion of cash and cash equivalents; it raised approximately $3.91 billion through ATM equity sales in the first nine months of 2026.
Rocket Lab reported FY2026 Q3 Space Systems revenue of $214.8 million and Launch Services revenue of $53.1 million.
Rocket Lab said its current rocket manufacturing rate was one rocket every eight days, 37.5% faster than a year earlier.
Rocket Lab expected 32.9% of its Q3-end backlog, approximately $1.17 billion, to convert to revenue within the following 12 months.
Management attributed Q3 gross margin above guidance to a full-quarter contribution from the acquired laser-communications business and stronger solar and optical-systems margins.

Management attributed sequential Q3 gross-margin decline to a mix shift toward lower-margin satellite platforms and the non-recurrence of Q2 one-time revenue recognition and launch-cancellation-fee income.
Twelve Rocket Lab-built spacecraft entered orbit in FY2026 Q3, including eight satellite platforms for Globalstar’s direct-to-device constellation.
Rocket Lab said more than 55 spacecraft were in development and build across its production complexes.
Rocket Lab furnished its FY2026 Q3 financial-results press release as Exhibit 99.1 to a Form 8-K.

Rocket Lab reported the pending Iridium acquisition was fully funded through a completed ATM equity offering, Iridium lenders had approved retaining the credit facility after closing, and Iridium shareholders had approved the transaction.
Rocket Lab’s November 9 results release reiterated that Neutron’s first launch was targeted for no earlier than 2027.
Rocket Lab scheduled its FY2026 Q3 financial-results webcast for 5:00 p.m. ET on November 9, 2026.
Rocket Lab said it wants to reserve approximately half of Neutron’s longer-term capacity for its own services.
Rocket Lab expected Neutron to achieve non-GAAP gross margin above 50% over the longer term.
Rocket Lab disclosed that it had recorded an expected loss provision for the Neutron second-flight vehicle in FY2026 Q3; no amount was disclosed.

Rocket Lab’s CFO said adjusted EBITDA was expected to turn positive within six months after Neutron’s first successful flight, while cash-flow breakeven would come later and depend on fleet-expansion investment.
